_note: Trinetra's A2A peer allowlist. These entries are ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLES describing agents the real agencies would have to operate themselves - none of these endpoints exist today, and Trinetra does not imply any of these organisations has agreed to anything. They are here to show the shape of the integration and to give the registry something concrete to be tested against. Replace base_url and trust with real, agreed values before any deployment. Registration is an allowlist: Trinetra will not call a URL that is not listed here.

peers.name: Central Railway crowd liaison
peers.note: Nashik Road station is a primary arrival point. A train arriving early is a crowd surge Trinetra cannot see. Prayagraj 2025 showed how a station crowd and a ghat crowd are the same crowd 40 minutes apart.

peers.name: NMC hospital bed liaison
peers.note: Trinetra's allocator models ambulances as a count. It has no idea whether the receiving hospital can take the patient.

peers.name: Gangapur Dam release desk
peers.note: Today Trinetra's discharge figure is typed in by hand. This is the peer that would replace that with a real planned-release number - the single highest-value A2A connection on this list.

peers.name: KumbhDoot pilgrim concierge
peers.note: Complementary rather than competing - see TRINETRA.md's prior-art note. A pilgrim already talking to KumbhDoot should not have to switch apps to reach a safety desk.
